cohort: Women undergoing in vitro fertilization/intracytoplasmic sperm injection (IVF/ICSI) treatment
finding: The presence of intra-cavitary fluid (ICF) was associated with a lower clinical pregnancy rate in women with previous cesarean delivery undergoing IVF/ICSI treatment, even after adjusting for confounding factors.
mod_finding: The study focuses on the impact of intra-cavitary fluid on pregnancy outcomes in women with previous cesarean sections undergoing IVF/ICSI treatment, and does not directly compare outcomes between different modes of delivery.
